purpose: Interpretation and audit only; no changes to the original event ledger or eligibility gate
selection: Bounded retrospective cases: largest early spike; interview/news context; two existing contrasting release examples; existing E17 final streaming date. These cases are illustrative and not a complete event census.

sources.title: Reddit r/Music Buckethead discussion
sources.kind: Primary platform record of a discussion, not authoritative discography
sources.verified: Thread discusses Buckethead's output and directly links the canonical Wikipedia article and discography.
sources.limits: Current post content and cumulative engagement do not establish original exposure or referral traffic. Album-count claims in its headline are not adopted as verified facts.

sources.title: Reddit daily archive, November 30, 2016
sources.verified: The same thread appears in the dated November 30, 2016 archive; search rendering also dates the thread to that day.
sources.limits: Exact UTC posting time and ordering relative to the daily pageview increase are not verified. The JSON endpoint was unavailable; no timestamp was invented.

sources.title: A Conversation with Buckethead — The Tools
sources.verified: Documents the Coming Alive conversation between Barry Michels and Buckethead.
sources.limits: The current blog index labels its page August 25, 2022. This migrated/reposted page date must not be substituted for the original 2017 episode date.

sources.title: Buckethead interview coverage — Loudwire
sources.verified: A dated report discusses the recent Coming Alive interview, establishing that the interview was public by October 12, 2017.
sources.limits: Used to date the coverage, not to make a present-day medical assessment or to establish referral causality.

sources.title: A Conversation With Buckethead — Listen Notes
sources.limits: Original RSS timestamp was not independently recovered. The report anchors the observed comparison to the documented October 12 coverage instead.

sources.title: November 2025 bot-traffic incident

sources.limits: Global incident does not establish article-specific effects; do not apply global percentages to this series.

sources.title: SARIMAX regression-with-SARIMA-errors formulation
sources.verified: Exogenous regressors enter a regression with SARIMA errors. Sign/formulation checked against installed statsmodels 0.14.5 source.
sources.limits: Documentation page is 0.14.4, not the fitted 0.14.5 environment. Installed source is authoritative for the local implementation.
